dashboard.label: Cost Analysis
dashboard.description: Quantify resource usage and cost savings from governance enforcement

search.query: | `analyze_search_costs` | search disabled=0 | stats sum(monthly_total_cost) as total_monthly_cost | eval display = "$".tostring(round(total_monthly_cost, 0))
| `analyze_search_costs` | search disabled=0 | stats sum(annual_cost) as total_annual_cost | eval display = "$".tostring(round(total_annual_cost, 0))

| inputlookup flagged_searches_lookup | search status="disabled" | join type=left search_name [| `analyze_search_costs` | rename title as search_name] | eval monthly_saved = if(isnotnull(monthly_total_cost), monthly_total_cost, 25) | stats sum(monthly_saved) as total_monthly_savings

| inputlookup flagged_searches_lookup | search status="disabled" | join type=left search_name [| `analyze_search_costs` | rename title as search_name] | eval monthly_saved = if(isnotnull(monthly_total_cost), monthly_total_cost, 25) | stats sum(monthly_saved) as total_monthly_savings | eval annual_savings = total_monthly_savings * 12
| inputlookup flagged_searches_lookup | search status="disabled" | stats count
| `analyze_search_costs` | search disabled=0 | stats sum(monthly_total_cost) as cost by app | sort - cost | head 15 | eval cost = round(cost, 2)
| `analyze_search_costs` | search disabled=0 | stats sum(monthly_total_cost) as cost by owner | sort - cost | head 15 | eval cost = round(cost, 2)

| `analyze_search_costs` | search disabled=0 | stats count by cost_tier | eval sort_order = case( cost_tier="Critical", 1, cost_tier="High", 2, cost_tier="Medium", 3, cost_tier="Low", 4, 1=1, 5) | sort sort_order | fields - sort_order

| `analyze_search_costs` | search disabled=0 | stats sum(monthly_cpu_cost) as "CPU Cost" sum(monthly_data_cost) as "Data Cost" sum(monthly_total_cost) as "Total Cost" | transpose | rename column as "Cost Type", "row 1" as "Monthly Cost ($)"

panel.title: Highest Cost Scheduled Searches - Optimization Candidates

search.query: | `analyze_search_costs` | search disabled=0 | eval monthly_cost_display = "$".tostring(round(monthly_total_cost, 2)) | eval annual_cost_display = "$".tostring(round(annual_cost, 2)) | table title, owner, app, cron_schedule, frequency_label, runs_per_month, monthly_cost_display, annual_cost_display, cost_tier | rename title as "Search Name", owner as "Owner", app as "App", cron_schedule as "Schedule", frequency_label as "Frequency", runs_per_month as "Runs/Month", monthly_cost_display as "Monthly Cost", annual_cost_display as "Annual Cost", cost_tier as "Cost Tier" | head 25

| inputlookup flagged_searches_lookup | search status="disabled" | join type=left search_name [| `analyze_search_costs` | rename title as search_name] | eval disabled_date = strftime(flagged_time, "%Y-%m-%d") | eval monthly_saved = if(isnotnull(monthly_total_cost), monthly_total_cost, 25) | eval monthly_saved_display = "$".tostring(round(monthly_saved, 2)) | eval annual_saved_display = "$".tostring(round(monthly_saved * 12, 2)) | table search_name, search_owner, search_app, disabled_date, monthly_saved_display, annual_saved_display, reason | rename search_name as "Search Name", search_owner as "Owner", search_app as "App", disabled_date as "Disabled Date", monthly_saved_display as "Monthly Savings", annual_saved_display as "Annual Savings", reason as "Reason" | sort - "Monthly Savings"

div.style: background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(83, 160, 81, 0.15) 0%, rgba(101, 166, 55, 0.15) 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(83, 160, 81, 0.3); border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; text-align: center;
div.p: This dashboard tracks the financial impact of governance actions on scheduled searches. By identifying and disabling wasteful or problematic searches, organizations can significantly reduce their Splunk operational costs while maintaining data quality and system performance.
